resources.string: Antigravity runs on your computer. This app connects to it from your phone: watch agents, send prompts, approve steps.
Enter a valid http:// or https:// address
No link found in the clipboard
If Google blocks sign-in here, continue in Chrome.

OPTION 1: Official Remote Control (recommended)

1. On your computer, open Antigravity → Settings (Ctrl+, / Cmd+,).
2. Turn on "Enable Remote Control" (Application or Account section, depending on the version). In the CLI: agy --remote-control, or /remote-control inside a session.
3. Keep the computer awake and Antigravity open.
4. In this app tap "Antigravity Remote Control (official)" and sign in with the SAME Google account.
5. Pick your computer in the instance switcher.

Tip: When Antigravity shows an "Open in Remote Control" QR code, scan it with the phone camera. The link opens in this app.

If Google refuses to sign in inside the app, use the "Chrome" button. Sign-in inside Chrome always works.

OPTION 2: Your own bridge
Any web address that exposes your computer works: code-server, a noVNC remote desktop, an open-source Antigravity mobile bridge, or a Cloudflare / Tailscale tunnel. Tap "Add connection" and enter its address.

Note: Antigravity cannot run natively on Android. The agents always run on your computer.
